apps.name: Hermano Mano
apps.description: An endless-runner game starring Hermano the dog — dodge, jump and snack your way up the footpath — plus a tracker for logging the dogs' meals and walks.

apps.name: EduDrop
apps.description: Offline classroom tool: the teacher's phone runs a local server and pushes lessons to students' browsers over local Wi-Fi. No internet, no accounts, no student app.

apps.name: Cardio
apps.description: A card table: five solitaire games (Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid) plus Thirteen, Canasta, Texas Hold'em and 500 against computer players.
